newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at an intra-day low of 8.3014 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.3003 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.

The yuan opened slightly lower at 8.3005 hitting an intra-day high of 8.3002 early in the session and then consolidating in a range of 8.3004 and 8.3008 for most of the session before closing at a low.
Trading was active with most done at 8.3005, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was still stable below the key 8.30 resistance level despite falls in the last few minutes.
"The fall ahead of the close had no impact on its short-term trend," a dealer said.
Dealers expect the yuan to continue its stable movement at just below the 8.30 level on Thursday.
The yuan closed up at 7.4380 from 7.4500 against 100 Japanese yen in dull trading and down slightly at 1.0739 from 1.0736 against the Hong Kong dollar.
